newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT to transfer software business to new unit.
newsitem.headline: NTT to transfer software business to new unit.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT) said on Wednesday that it would transfer its software development-related business to a new subsidiary that will be set up in March 1997.
NTT president Junichiro Miyazu told a news conference that about 10,000 NTT employees were now involved in the software development-related business, including the design of local area networks.

NTT will also transfer sales and maintenance of telecommunications equipment to one of its units in the 1996/97 business year. NTT will also transfer its telephone directory enquiry service to another unit by the end of 1998/99, Miyazu said.
Miyazu said NTT hopes to raise its fees for the directory service, but added that nothing has been decided.
